text: Anti-Money Laundering (AML) Software: Software solutions for detecting and preventing financial crimes, including transaction monitoring, customer due diligence, and sanctions screening.; Anti-Money Laundering; AML; AML Software; Transaction Monitoring; KYC; Know Your Customer; Financial Crime Prevention; Sanctions Screening; Suspicious Activity Reporting
reasons: GeM does not have a specific 'AML Software' category; these solutions are typically classified under broad IT services like 'Software Development' or 'IT Hardware/Software' which are too vague to filter effectively without excluding relevant results.
